parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: SecurityEventId
parameters.description: The ID of the security alert.

parameters.name: SimilarEventScenarioCode
parameters.description: The code of the alerting event that has the same type or rule hits.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.
